content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 18.9 is mutual and largely meets the ASSIGN fallback — either Party may assign to an acquirer of substantially all its business/assets without consent, with a written assumption delivered to the non-assigning Party, and all other assignments (including to an Affiliate) require written consent. The single material gap was the unqualified consent gate for non-successor assignments, which I cured with a surgical insertion of "which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed". Change of control poses no risk to Ono: Sections 18.10 and 4.5(b) address only a Change in Control of Array and confer no Array termination or re-pricing right on Ono's change of control.
